inspect.zh: 蛋白质结构被简化为几块曲面。
inspect.en: The draft simplifies the protein into broad shapes.

repair.zh: 恢复结构细节，保留外围文字与连接。
repair.en: Restore the structural detail and retain the surrounding labels and connections.

inspect.zh: 密集点云变成了稀疏、规则的圆点。
inspect.en: The dense point cloud becomes a sparse, regular dot pattern.

repair.zh: 恢复原图中的密集点云。
repair.en: Restore the dense point cloud from the source.

issues.source_evidence: SOURCE point-cloud panel upper half contains a dense multicolor scatter cluster with many overlapping orange/yellow/green/cyan points.
issues.initial_evidence: INITIAL point-cloud panel upper half contains far fewer dots arranged in a sparse, regular-looking distribution.
issues.repair: Replace the sparse regular dot field in the upper point-cloud area with a dense overlapping multicolor scatter cluster matching the SOURCE appearance, while preserving the surrounding dotted panel and label.

issues.source_evidence: SOURCE first post-module structure panel shows a detailed cyan/teal protein ribbon with fine strands, helices, and red/yellow loop details in the upper portion.
issues.initial_evidence: INITIAL first post-module structure panel shows simplified broad abstract teal shapes with much less ribbon detail.
issues.repair: Redraw the upper portion of the first post-module protein as the detailed cyan/teal ribbon cartoon seen in SOURCE, retaining the panel border and sequence label placement.

issues.source_evidence: SOURCE Final Result panel upper portion shows a detailed tan/brown protein ribbon rendering with fine strand and helix geometry.
issues.initial_evidence: INITIAL Final Result panel upper portion shows simplified abstract tan/brown patch shapes rather than a detailed protein ribbon.
issues.repair: Redraw the upper portion of the Final Result protein as the detailed tan/brown ribbon cartoon from SOURCE, preserving the title and surrounding dotted border.

issues.source_evidence: SOURCE point-cloud panel lower half continues as a dense overlapping multicolor scatter cluster.
issues.initial_evidence: INITIAL point-cloud panel lower half continues as a sparse regular dot field with fewer points.
issues.repair: Replace the sparse lower point-cloud dots with the dense overlapping SOURCE-like multicolor point cluster, without changing the sequence label below.

issues.source_evidence: SOURCE shows only a blank gap/dotted-panel separation between the tensor/matrix panel and the point-cloud panel; no right-pointing connector arrow is visible there.
issues.initial_evidence: INITIAL adds a black right-pointing arrow from the tensor/matrix panel into the point-cloud panel.
issues.repair: Remove the extra right-pointing arrow between the tensor/matrix panel and the point-cloud panel, leaving the spacing/borders as in SOURCE.

issues.source_evidence: SOURCE lower portion of the first post-module structure remains a detailed cyan/teal ribbon protein with fine strand/loop geometry.
issues.initial_evidence: INITIAL lower portion of the first post-module structure is simplified into large abstract teal patches and curves.
issues.repair: Redraw the lower portion of the first post-module protein to match the detailed SOURCE ribbon geometry, preserving the existing label area.

issues.source_evidence: SOURCE lower portion of the Final Result panel shows a detailed tan/brown ribbon protein with fine structural elements and yellow loop detail.
issues.initial_evidence: INITIAL lower portion of the Final Result panel uses simplified tan/brown abstract patches with reduced structural detail.
issues.repair: Redraw the lower portion of the Final Result protein as the detailed SOURCE ribbon cartoon, keeping the sequence and CDR label placement unchanged.

receipt.acceptance_scope: Actual unchanged native validators, exact scoped plan execution and rendered artifact identity. Not a claim visual issues all pass.

unresolved.reason: Erroneous first-stage observation. Re-reading SOURCE shows a short black right-pointing connector arrow between the tensor/matrix panel and the point-cloud panel, matching INITIAL arrow_repr_to_cloud. Removing it would damage correct topology.
